# laminar_dataset (Resource)

Manages a Laminar dataset. Terraform manages the dataset itself; datapoints are data and are added through the SDKs, CLI, or API.

~> **Warning:** Destroying a dataset permanently deletes all of its datapoints.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laminar_dataset" "golden" {
  name = "golden-set"

  lifecycle {
    # Destroying a dataset deletes its datapoints.
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Dataset name. Names do not need to be unique.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Dataset UUID.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project that owns the dataset.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laminar_dataset.golden <dataset-uuid>
```
